decisions.reason: Established government use and strong fit with the firm's travel-security operations mean the product's value is already demonstrated and inexpensive to continue exploiting.
The API remains strategically adjacent and likely not very costly to maintain, so a large expanding firm would usually keep the option open despite still limited market proof.
As a close extension of the firm's training offer, it is likely cheap to keep available while cross-selling potential to existing security clients continues to be tested.
After another year without clear evidence of traction, this more validation-intensive system looks like a relatively costly option whose uncertainty has resolved enough to justify abandoning it.
The platform sits close to the firm's core document and passenger-processing services, so keeping it on the market preserves a useful low-cost option with credible strategic fit.
